column1: Prep all the ingredients before you start cooking.
Bring the broth to a simmer and keep it hot.
Heat the oil in a paella pan over medium heat and brown the meat until crisp. Set aside.
Quarter the pepper lengthwise, fry it in the pan, and set aside for garnish.
Saute the flat beans 2–3 minutes, add the onion for 3–4 minutes, then the garlic for 2–3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, saffron, and smoked paprika and cook briefly.
Return the meat to the pan with the white beans and stir. Add the rice, stir, then pour in all the hot broth and raise the heat to high.
Season with salt and pepper and stir gently.
Once boiling, lower to a gentle simmer and cook 15 minutes without stirring.
Turn off the heat and let it rest 10 minutes.
Return to high heat for 2–5 minutes until the liquid is gone and a crust forms on the bottom.
Arrange the peppers on top and serve right away.
